text: {"table": {"name": "atom", "purpose": "One row per atom in a collection of molecules (TR### identifiers). Each atom belongs to a molecule and has an element symbol. Atoms are connected via the 'connected' table and bonds via the 'bond' table."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "atom_id", "description": "Primary key. Referenced by the 'connected' table (both endpoint columns), which links atoms to each other.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "molecule_id", "description": "Foreign key to molecule.col_001. The molecule (TR###) this atom belongs to; the numeric suffix of col_001 matches this value.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "category", "name": "element", "description": "Chemical element symbol of the atom, lowercase (h, c, o, n, cl, br, p, si, zn, ...). 21 distinct elements across the dataset.", "status": "resolved"}}}
